mainEntity.name: What is the shell made of?

acceptedAnswer.text: The bag has a polycarbonate hard shell. It is designed to be durable and lightweight.

mainEntity.name: How do I unlock the TSA lock?

acceptedAnswer.text: Push the latch toward the numbers to unlock it. Instructions to set your lock code are inside the luggage.

mainEntity.name: Will a 15.6-inch laptop fit in the front compartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the front compartment fits a 15.6-inch laptop, a laptop charger and documents.

mainEntity.name: How much does the bag hold?

acceptedAnswer.text: The bag has a capacity of 41 L and measures 56 x 35.6 x 25 cm. It weighs 3.29 kg.

mainEntity.name: Can I return the bag if it does not suit me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the store offers 30-day returns. Cash on delivery is also available.
